experiment.topic: BTC-USD price reversion after sharp 5% drop in 20-hour window
experiment.hypothesis: After a 5% drop in BTC-USD price within a 20-hour window, the price will revert to its 20-hour moving average within the next 3 hours with a probability greater than 50%.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If BTC-USD price reverts to its 20-hour moving average by more than 5% within the next 3 hours after a sharp drop, and this occurs in at least 3 independent 1-hour price windows, the hypothesis is falsified. If no such reversion occurs, the hypothesis remains untested.
